bullets: Own end-to-end delivery and iteration of new trading products — from requirements and specs to launch, post-launch analysis, and continuous optimization.
Build community and creator driven experiences that help users discover opportunities and make better trading decisions.
Design and scale user growth programs — referral, invite, rewards, and partner incentives, including attribution, reward logic, settlement, and abuse prevention.
Explore and build new products around tokenized real-world assets (RWA), bringing new asset classes to on-chain trading while handling their unique requirements.
Apply a deep understanding of Web3 fundamentals, DEX mechanics, and market data to product decisions, ensuring new products are built on a solid trading foundation.
Own the data platform roadmap - Define and deliver the product roadmap for our data platform — covering data ingestion, on-chain data parsing, metrics frameworks…
Build on-chain data capabilities - Lead multi-chain data ingestion and parsing (EVM, Solana, Bitcoin, Cosmos, etc.). Define standardized parsing logic for transactions, transfers…
Own token and market data - Own the selection and governance of token metadata, pricing, and liquidity data sources. Establish source priority, fallback, and cross-validation…
Serve downstream consumers - Partner with business, growth, risk, and BI teams to package data capabilities into APIs, datasets, and self-serve analytics tools that cut the cost…
Data quality and governance - Build monitoring, metric definition management, and incident response processes. Eliminate the "same metric, five definitions" problem.
Lead product strategy and execution for wallet infrastructure — chain integration, account models (EOA, MPC, AA/smart accounts), key management, and recovery flows.
Define and drive the standards and processes for onboarding new blockchains and tokens into the wallet, partnering with engineering, BD, and partner teams to execute smoothly.
Own the reliability, performance, and security of core wallet infra — balancing feature velocity with stability, accuracy, and defense-in-depth.
Research emerging blockchain ecosystems and account standards, evaluating technical trade-offs and translating them into product decisions and roadmap priorities.
Partner closely with engineering throughout the build and iteration cycle, ensuring technical solutions are delivered on time and align with user needs.
